summary: Iteration 4 (Post-Run Logging + Achievement Badges + Group Weekly Leaderboard) reviewed end-to-end. Backend: 15/15 iteration-4 pytest PASSED (100%). Full suite: 66/67 PASSED — the 1 failure is the known-stale iter-2 register_push_controlled_error test (already flagged in iter-3 report; endpoint is now auth-gated so 401 is correct). Verified: (1) POST /api/workouts/{id}/log validates distance_km>0 & duration_seconds>0 (Pydantic 422), 404 on unknown workout, correctly computes pace (duration/distance) and returns 'M:SS'; a second POST UPSERTS the same run_logs record (same id) and updates values — enforced by unique index on (workout_id,user_id). (2) GET /api/workouts/{id} returns my_log scoped to the caller (demo sees None on new_user's log, new_user sees own). (3) Stats derive from run_logs: demo shows total_km=41.0, total_runs=4, longest_km=18.0, best_pace='4:00', streak_weeks>=1; a fresh user has zeros/null; after logging 6km/30min stats jump to total_runs=1, total_km=6.0, longest=6.0, best='5:00'; after upsert to 10km/40min → total_runs still 1, total_km=10.0, longest=10.0, best='4:00'. (4) Badges: 7 total; demo has first_run+ten_k+speedster+social earned, half/century/streak4 locked; new user has none; new user earns first_run immediately after logging. (5) Leaderboard: GET /api/groups/{id}/leaderboard returns members ranked by last-7d km desc with rank; two-member test group shows new_user rank 1 (10 km) and demo rank 2 (0 km); Dawn Patrol Runners shows Alex Rivera rank 1 with km>0 (7d window catches -3d and -6d seed logs). (6) Cancel /api/workouts/{id} deletes associated run_logs (verified stats fall back to zero for new_user). (7) Regression: search 'oakland' (city vibe), 'marathon' (category vibe), 'headlands' (description vibe) all match; reminder_prefs PUT whitelisting drops 'bogus'; /register-push requires auth (401 without token). Frontend (390x844): Profile shows PERSONAL BESTS (18 km / 4:00) and ACHIEVEMENTS 4/7 grid with First Steps, 10K Club, Speed Demon earned + Half Marathon, Century, On Fire locked (icons + labels correct). Group detail page shows THIS WEEK leaderboard card with rank + avatar + km. Console still shows deprecated RN-Web 'shadow*' + 'props.pointerEvents' warnings — pre-existing.

minor.issue: No check that run_date is in the past — a user can log a future workout. Consider rejecting logs for workouts whose workout_date > now (or at least warning). Currently a bug-abuse vector for gaming badges/leaderboard.

No membership check — any authenticated user can log a run against a workout in a group they don't belong to (since GET /workouts/{id} isn't gated either). Consider requiring approved/admin membership.

run_date is stored as ISO string; comparing to another ISO string via $gte works only because the format is lexicographically sortable. Fine today but fragile if timezone offsets ever differ per row. Consider storing as native datetime.

issues: Pre-existing RN-Web warnings: 'shadow*' → boxShadow, 'props.pointerEvents' → style.pointerEvents. Non-blocking.

action_items: (LOW) Reject POST /api/workouts/{id}/log when workout_date > now to prevent logging future runs.
(LOW) Require approved/admin membership on POST /api/workouts/{id}/log and consider gating GET /api/workouts/{id} the same way — currently any authed user can view/log any workout.

(HOUSEKEEPING) Remove or update stale /app/backend/tests/test_iteration_2.py::TestRegisterPush::test_register_push_controlled_error — endpoint was auth-gated in iter-3; assertion still expects 500/502 but now sees 401. Same action was recommended in iter-3 report and remains unfixed.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:612 log_run creates unique index (workout_id,user_id) so upsert semantics are enforced at the DB level — nice. Handles both branches (existing vs new) explicitly and returns the same id on update, which the frontend log page relies on for the Edit flow.

server.py:840 leaderboard filters logs by (group_id,user_id,run_date>=week_start) then sums client-side. Sort is stable via list.sort(). Rank is assigned by index — ties get sequential ranks (not competition ranking); acceptable for MVP but worth noting.
server.py:807 badges route recomputes stats independently instead of calling my_stats — duplicate logic (~15 lines) with /my/stats. Consider extracting a helper to keep them in sync.
server.py:589 cancel_workout correctly cascades run_logs deletion; rsvps also deleted. Reminders_sent NOT cleaned up though — could leave orphan dedupe records; harmless but grows unbounded.

server.py:625 log_run stores run_date = workout_date, so leaderboard's 7d window is anchored to when the session was scheduled, not when the user actually ran. Reasonable trade-off but be aware if you later allow logging retroactively.
workout/[id].tsx isPast check uses Date.now() vs workout_date; renders 'Log/Edit Your Run' CTA which routes to /workout/log with pre-filled distance/mins/secs when my_log exists — good UX for edits.
workout/log.tsx client-side validates distance>0 AND total>0 before POST; backend also enforces via Pydantic gt=0. Belt+suspenders.

success_rate.backend: 100% (15/15 iter-4; 66/67 full suite — 1 known-stale iter-2 test)
